values.zh-CN: 从 Prop 出发的受限消去

values.en: Inductive propositions ordinarily eliminate freely into Prop, but elimination into a data-bearing Type universe is restricted. Empty or singleton-like propositions may receive stronger elimination principles; the exact exception set is system-dependent. The restriction prevents an arbitrary proof in impredicative Prop from being inspected to manufacture computational data.
values.zh-CN: 归纳命题通常可以自由消去到 Prop，但消去到携带数据的 Type 宇宙会受到限制。空命题或近似单构造子的命题可能具有更强的消去原则；具体例外取决于所采用的类型论系统。这项限制防止检查非直谓 Prop 中的任意证明并据此制造计算数据。
